summary: Distributed for information only, this RFC provides an alpha update of the X Window System Protocol, version 11, as of April 1987. It says the system has been widely reviewed and tested, and encourages the Internet community to experiment with it. It does not establish an Internet standard.

eli5.summary: It is the rulebook for how a program on one computer can draw windows on another computer's screen, shared with the public to try out.

questions: what is the x window system protocol
how does x11 work over a network
